title: Real-time thermal self-energies: In the variational bases and spaces
summary: In this work, we introduce a systematic study for studying the scalar propagator and tadpole self-energy by considering an arbitrary parameter $σ$ that allows for a path integral description in real-time formalism (RTF). The closed time path formalism (CTP) and Thermofield Dynamics (TFD) are two popular choices for the parameter $σ$ in the Feynman rules. We have constructed a scalar propagator and a tadpole self-energy in two different bases in the momentum space as well as the mixed space.
